notes.title: In Verbis Virtus full release now live!
notes.content:
In Verbis Virtus is finally complete, thanks to all of you who supported us during the Early Access!

Here is version 1.0.2310 changelog:

- Added Chapter 3, with two new spells, new monsters and the final boss
- Final version of the boss-fight at the end of Chapter 2
- Steam achievements integration
- Steam Trading Cards
- New Main Menu
- Minor graphical and sound updates
- Minor bug fixes

Important: German, French and Chinese localizations will be completed in future updates. 
We apologize for the inconvenience

notes.title: Update 0.8.2063 now live!
notes.content:
Here is version 0.8.2063 changelog:

IMPORTANT: the game has a new save system. If you load an old saved game you will start from the beginning of the level, but your spells and journal will be kept, so you can skip some puzzles. Anyway we made so many changes and improvements that it’s worth playing the game from scratch.

- Added boss to Chapter 2
- New spell
- More monsters in Chapter 2
- Maps can be found around the levels
- Added save points where you can save whenever you like
- Performance enhancements
- Resolved many glitches in player’s movements and collisions
- Minor changes to the topology of the levels
- Dozens of bug fixes and improvements

Chapter 3, with new puzzles, spells and monsters is coming with the final release on April, 3. Stay tuned!

tags.feature: - Maps can be found around the levels
- Added save points where you can save whenever you like

tags.bug: - Resolved many glitches in player’s movements and collisions
- Dozens of bug fixes and improvements

- Savegame compatibility should be preserved
- Fixed bug that caused some objects to disappear after loading a saved games
- Fixed bug that blocked magic spheres in the Decay Way
- Will-o’-wisps are now vulnerable again due to some balancing
- Fixes related to the savage
- Fixed adhesion on surfaces of “mark of fire”
- Added more effects in high level of quality
- Many minor graphical tweaks
- Added some sounds

It may be necessary to reload a previous save for some fixes to take effect.
